cards.mood: The piece opens with a serene, pastoral intimacy that gradually accumulates emotional weight and sonic density.
cards.palette: A steel-string acoustic guitar serves as the harmonic backbone, utilizing a steady strumming pattern that persists from the Intro through the Outro, providing rhythmic drive and chordal structure.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Golden light hits the ancient pines,
Where the river carves its path of stone,
Roots reach deep in the quiet ground,
Where the wild and the restless roam.
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind whispers secrets in the leaves,
Truth is woven in the branches overhead.
[Chorus]
Stand tall through the shifting seasons,
Strong as the mountains, deep as the soul,
Hold firm when the storm clouds gather,
Finding the peace that makes the broken whole.
[Verse]
Frost paints silver on the morning grass,
Shadows stretch long across the plain,
One lone hawk circles the open sky,
Dancing steady through the mist and rain.
[Pre-Chorus]
The earth breathes slow beneath my feet,
A steady pulse in the heart of the wild.
[Chorus]
Stand tall through the shifting seasons,
Strong as the mountains, deep as the soul,
Hold firm when the storm clouds gather,
Finding the peace that makes the broken whole.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Old roots anchor the heavy wood,
New life blooms where the giants stood.
[Chorus]
Stand tall through the shifting seasons,
Strong as the mountains, deep as the soul,
Hold firm when the storm clouds gather,
Finding the peace that makes the broken whole.
[Outro]
